title: The low that wasn't
headline: The Nov 6 low wasn't the low.
dek: On Nov 6, four 30th Celebration promos halved in one reading. Each then rose, by 14% to 40%, to a peak between Nov 8 and Nov 10, and has fallen on every reading since. By Nov 13 Pikachu ex 107 was at $24.49, 31% below its Nov 6 reading; Espeon ex 108 at $43.59, 26% below; Pikachu ex 109 at $27.15, 23% below; Umbreon ex 110 at $71.80, 9% below. A floor called on Nov 9 would have been wrong by Nov 13. No sale was checked behind any of it.
why_now: Between Nov 8 and Nov 10 these four were up from Nov 6, and it would have been easy to say the bottom was in. The board doesn't call bottoms, and this is the week that shows why: its language rule bans promises about where a price is going, and the readings since show what such a call would have cost.
risk: Four cards from one promo set over one week is not a market. The fall could be one story or four; price data can't say which. Eevee 114/103 from Delta Reign did not follow the same path: $25.33 on Nov 13, 23% above its Nov 6 low of $20.60 and 14% below its Nov 9 peak. The readings are TCGplayer's market price on the dates shown, not a daily series; Pikachu ex 109 has no reading on Nov 7 or Nov 8. No sale was checked behind any of this. This is not a read on whether these prices are high or low.
what_to_watch: Whether any of the four stops falling: the readings to see it with are on the board's lists each morning, and on Nov 14's since-yesterday list all four fell, by 8% to 26% in a day. Whether the 7-day list keeps showing them as their week rolls past the Nov 6 readings. And an idea, not built: a short row of the last seven readings beside each move, so the table shows the path as well as the change.
source: TCGplayer market prices via tcgcsv.com, from the board's published lists of Nov 5 to Nov 14, 2026 (readings Nov 5 to Nov 13)

Pikachu ex 109: $35.28 (Nov 6), $38.67 (Nov 9), $40.17 (Nov 10), $35.08, $29.59, $27.15 (Nov 13). Espeon ex 108: $58.92 (Nov 6), $82.52 (Nov 8), $77.35, $74.92, $65.93, $57.79, $43.59 (Nov 13). Umbreon ex 110: $79.13 (Nov 6), $79.99, $82.09, $90.67 (Nov 9), $89.75, $85.63, $79.34, $71.80 (Nov 13). The table: the four cards on the board's Nov 14 7-day list, the change between 3-day medians at each end; start-of-week prices are worked back from the listed price and its rounded change, so within a dollar. The list: up to 10 Pokémon cards worth $20 or more that moved 5% or more in a week; with no checked sales, a move shows only if it's 60% or less, the lowest listing moved the same way by at least a quarter as much, the price changed in the last 2 days, and the card trades. Unconfirmed: no sale checked by Mission Control's Sale Integrity Layer in that window. Not advice.
